crossRefs.note: The border from the sea, shall be Hazar Enon at the border of Damascus; and on the north northward is the border of…

people.name: Hazar-enan
people.line: Town on the northern border of Israel

people.name: Ziphron
people.line: A place on the northern border of the Promised Land

translations.web: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
translations.bsb: continue to Ziphron, and end at Hazar-enan. This will be your boundary on the north.
translations.kjv: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.
translations.asv: and the border shall go forth to Ziphron, and the goings out thereof shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.
